checks.description: Every raw row is exactly one of kept, duplicate, or rejected.
Only outer-whitespace trimming and declared derivations may alter raw values.
A missing raw value cannot become substantive without a declared derivation.
Declared unit conversions are independently recomputed with decimal arithmetic.
Only full-row duplicates inside the same configured context may be removed.
Fresh normalization runs emit identical semantic records and changes.
Input row/column permutations preserve semantic content and group counts.
Padding and irrelevant columns do not change normalized original fields.
JSON is strict, finite, complete, and agrees with CSV.
Every counterexample and reviewable exclusion/derivation has a queue entry.
Each kept row resolves to exactly one existing raw source row.

scope_limit: Process quality control only; no automated claim of scientific conflict resolution.
